tags.name: Account
tags.description: Inspect the authenticated account — profile, credit balance, and accessible workspaces.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Bloom API key, for example `x-api-key: bloom_sk_...`.

bearer.description: Bloom API key (`Bearer bloom_sk_...`) or Bloom OAuth access token.

get.description: Return basic profile information for the authenticated API key owner. Useful as a whoami probe to verify which account a key belongs to.
List brand sessions with cursor-based pagination. Use the returned IDs as brandSessionId when generating images.

schema.description: Team workspace ID. Scopes results to that workspace. Omit to list across every workspace the caller can see.
Results per page (1–100, default 50)
Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor

post.description: Queue brand onboarding for a website or Instagram profile URL. Returns 202 with an analyzing brand after the durable workflow is accepted. Call GET /brands/{id}?wait=true and generate only when status is "ready". `collectImages=false` skips background image-library collection, not crawling or visual DNA. Defaults to the caller's personal workspace; pass `workspaceId` to onboard into a team workspace.

url.description: Website or Instagram profile URL to analyze (e.g. https://acme.com or https://instagram.com/acme)

workspaceId.description: Team workspace ID. The brand is created in that workspace and billed to its customer. Omit to create in the caller's personal workspace.

logoUrl.description: Explicit logo URL. If provided, skips automatic logo extraction.

collectImages.description: Whether to collect background images from the website/Instagram into the brand's image library. This does not skip brand initialization, crawling, or visual DNA analysis.

message.default: Workspace not found or not accessible

get.description: Get a brand by ID. When status is "ready", the brand can generate images. If status is "logo_required", provide a logo via PUT /brands/{id}/logo. A failed brand includes public-safe failure details. Use wait=true to hold the connection until ready, logo_required, or failed; a timeout returns the current analyzing resource.

schema.description: Brand ID
Hold the connection until the resource reaches a terminal status
Max seconds to wait (default 120, max 295)

delete.description: Delete a brand by ID. Returns the deleted brand's id, name, and owning workspace. Deleting the same brand twice returns 404.

schema.description: Brand ID

put.description: Update the logo for a brand session. Downloads and validates the logo, then starts (or restarts) visual DNA extraction and returns status "analyzing". Common when status is "logo_required", but also works for replacing an existing logo on ready brands.

schema.description: Brand ID

logoUrl.description: Direct URL to the logo image (PNG, JPG, SVG, or WEBP)

message.default: Logo could not be downloaded or validated

put.description: Update the logo for a brand by uploading raw bytes (multipart/form-data). Use this when the logo is local — for remote URLs, use PUT /brands/{id}/logo. Validates and processes the file (SVG and AVIF are converted to PNG; transparency gets an optimal background), then starts (or restarts) visual DNA extraction.

schema.description: Brand ID

file.description: Logo file (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, or AVIF, max 10MB)

put.description: Update the logo for a brand by uploading raw bytes (multipart/form-data) using a short-lived, single-use token minted via the bloom_create_logo_upload_url MCP tool. The token in the path is the credential — no Authorization header is expected. Same validation/storage pipeline as PUT /brands/{id}/logo/file.

schema.description: Brand ID
Short-lived upload token from bloom_create_logo_upload_url

file.description: Logo file (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, or AVIF, max 10MB)

message.default: Upload token is invalid, expired, or already used

get.description: List images scoped to a brand or across all brands, with cursor-based pagination. Supports filtering by status and action type. Returns short redirect URLs (/img/{id}) for completed images by default. When `ids` is provided, pass `wait=true` to hold the connection until every referenced image reaches a terminal status (use this to collect results from a fire-and-forget batch of generations).

schema.description: Comma-separated image IDs to filter by (max 50). Returns only the specified images.
Team workspace ID. Scopes results to that workspace. Omit to list across every workspace the caller can see.
Brand session ID (from GET /brands). Omit to list images across all brands.
Results per page (1–100, default 50)
Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor
Filter by image source. "generated" = AI-created, "uploaded" = user uploads, "scraped" = website images from brand onboarding
Filter by generation status (only applies to generated images — uploaded/scraped images are excluded when this filter is active)
Filter by action type (only applies to generated images — uploaded/scraped images are excluded when this filter is active)
Include signed download URLs for completed images
Hold the connection until every image referenced by `ids` reaches a terminal status. No-op when `ids` is omitted.
Max seconds to wait (default 120, max 295)

delete.description: Delete up to 50 images by id in one call.

schema.description: Comma-separated image IDs to delete (1-50).

deletedCount.description: How many images were deleted. May be lower than the number of ids passed — ids that aren't yours or were already deleted are skipped, not errored.

get.description: Get an image by ID. Use this to poll for generation results. When status is "completed", imageUrl contains a short redirect URL (/img/{id}). Use wait=true to hold the connection until a terminal status is reached. When status is "failed" and failureReason is "content_safety", the prompt was blocked by the provider's content filter — retry with model "standard" (more permissive) or revise the prompt.

schema.description: Image ID — works for generated, uploaded, and scraped images
Hold the connection until the resource reaches a terminal status
Max seconds to wait (default 120, max 295)

delete.description: Delete a single image by ID (generated, uploaded, or scraped). Returns the deleted image's id, source, and owning workspace. Deleting the same image twice returns 404.

schema.description: Image ID — works for generated, uploaded, and scraped images

post.description: Start an image generation. Returns immediately with the image ID(s). Poll GET /images/{id} to check status and retrieve the result. Optionally include referenceImageIds for style/content guidance.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate (1–2000 chars)

model.description: Model tier. "fast" (cheaper/faster), "standard" (mid tier), or "pro" (default, highest quality).

variantCount.description: Number of variant images to generate (1-5, default 1). Each variant costs the same credits.

referenceImageIds.description: IDs of uploaded or generated images to use as style/content references (max 10)

message.default: Brand session is not fully onboarded

action_url.description: Deep link to /pricing for the caller to top up credits

message.default: Subscription paused — complete payment to resume

action_url.description: Deep link to /pricing to complete the pending payment

message.default: 4K generation isn't included with your current plan
Brand is not ready for image generation

post.description: Edit a previously generated or uploaded image. The prompt describes what to change. Aspect ratio is locked to the original image's ratio. Optionally include referenceImageIds for additional context. Returns immediately with a new image ID. Poll GET /images/{id} to check status and retrieve the result.

schema.description: ID of a completed or uploaded image to edit

prompt.description: What to change — describe the edit (e.g. "make the background blue"). Aspect ratio is locked to the original image's ratio.

model.description: Model tier. "fast" (cheaper/faster), "standard" (mid tier), or "pro" (default, highest quality).

referenceImageIds.description: IDs of uploaded or generated images for additional context (max 9)

message.default: Image must be completed before editing
Brand session is not fully onboarded

action_url.description: Deep link to /pricing for the caller to top up credits

message.default: Subscription paused — complete payment to resume

action_url.description: Deep link to /pricing to complete the pending payment

Brand is not ready for image generation

Returns immediately with a new image ID; the cutout typically completes in under 10 seconds. Poll GET /images/{id} to check status and retrieve the result.

schema.description: ID of a completed generated image, or an uploaded/scraped image, to remove the background from

message.default: Source image must be completed before removing background
Vector images don't have a background to remove. Pick a raster image.
Not enough credits to remove background

post.description: Vectorize a raster image to SVG. Works on completed generated images and on uploaded/scraped images. Best for logos, icons, and flat artwork; photos give poor results. Returns immediately with a new image ID. Poll GET /images/{id} to check status and retrieve the result.

schema.description: ID of a completed generated image, or an uploaded/scraped image, to vectorize

message.default: Source image must be completed before vectorizing
Source image is already a vector (SVG)
Source image is below the vectorizer's minimum dimensions

post.description: Upload an image by URL for use as a reference or edit subject. The server downloads and validates the image, then reuses an exact match in the brand session or stores a new one. Returns the canonical image ID and whether it already existed.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image to upload (PNG, JPG, WebP). Server downloads and stores the image.

brandSessionId.description: Brand session to scope this upload to

existing.description: Whether Bloom reused an exact image already in this brand session

message.default: Please provide a valid, publicly reachable URL.
Failed to download image from URL

post.description: Upload raw image bytes (multipart/form-data) for use as a reference or edit subject. Use this when the image is local — for remote URLs, use POST /images/uploads. Returns the canonical image ID and whether an exact match already existed in the brand session.

file.description: Image file (PNG, JPEG, WebP, or AVIF, max 10MB). AVIF is converted to PNG server-side.

brandSessionId.description: Brand session to scope this upload to

existing.description: Whether Bloom reused an exact image already in this brand session

post.description: Upload raw image bytes (multipart/form-data) using a short-lived, single-use token minted via the bloom_create_image_upload_url MCP tool. The token in the path is the credential — no Authorization header is expected. Uses the same exact-match reuse pipeline as POST /images/uploads/file and returns the canonical image ID.

schema.description: Short-lived upload token from bloom_create_image_upload_url

file.description: Image file (PNG, JPEG, WebP, or AVIF, max 10MB). AVIF is converted to PNG server-side.

existing.description: Whether Bloom reused an exact image already in this brand session

message.default: Upload token is invalid, expired, or already used

post.description: Semantic search (powered by vector embeddings) over the brand session's library images, ranked nearest-first. Library images are those whose `source` is `uploaded` (added by the user) or `scraped` (pulled in during onboarding) — generated images are excluded. Pass `cursor` from the previous response to paginate.

brandSessionId.description: Brand session UUID to search within

query.description: Visual concept to search for. Plain noun phrases work best — e.g., 'drone in flight', 'team working at desks', 'product on white background'.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor

maxDistance.description: Cosine-distance cutoff (smaller = stricter). Default 0.7 gives good relevance for most queries; loosen for long-tail matches, tighten for stricter recall. Distances above this threshold are dropped.

get.description: Check the remaining credit balance for a workspace. Defaults to the caller's personal workspace; pass `workspaceId` to query a team workspace's balance.

schema.description: Team workspace ID. Omit to check the personal workspace balance.

message.default: Workspace not found or not accessible

get.description: List the workspaces the caller can access. The personal workspace (is_personal: true) is listed first and is the default for create operations (omit workspace_id to use it). List endpoints span all workspaces unless a workspace_id is given.
